release: PATCH on 6.1.2, from a full false-data audit of 62 stored reports. Two findings, both in code shipped hours earlier. FIX 1 - single-page runs reported sitemap membership as NOT CHECKED when the answer was already paid for: crawl.js resolves sitemaps to build the page seed even on a one-page run, so crawl.sitemapUrls was populated and simply not read. Membership and file VALIDATION are now separate concerns - membership comes free from the crawl, validation (limits, lastmod, foreign hosts) still needs the extra fetches and stays whole-site only. A This-page run on a listed URL now correctly says yes. Crawl-sourced membership FLAGS existing rows and never mints new ones, so the table still shows exactly the page that was asked for. FIX 2 - the coverage explainer added in 6.1.2 led with Every discovered URL was requested unconditionally, printing it directly above 89 were never reached on a single-page run: two claims contradicting each other in one line. The lead is conditional now, and the wording says NOT REQUESTED rather than never reached, because a deliberate scope choice is not a coverage failure. NEW TOOL: testing/report-integrity.js, a false-data hunter that interrogates stored report ARTIFACTS rather than code - reconciles every count, refuses green ticks without evidence, catches verdicts that contradict their own stated reason, and fails any report claiming live index membership. It found both defects above plus the two already fixed in 6.1.1/6.1.2, none of which the unit suites had caught. Its own first draft raised 150 phantom violations by substring-matching no noindex inside a clean reason string; an auditor that cries wolf is worse than none, so every rule matches exact shapes.
